name: get_pod_status
description: Retrieve current status, phase, container states, ready conditions, and restart counts for a Kubernetes Pod.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the target pod.

pod.description: The name of the target pod.

name: get_pod_events
description: Retrieve chronological Kubernetes Events associated with a specific Pod to inspect scheduling, image pulling, and lifecycle errors.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the target pod.

pod.description: The name of the target pod.

name: get_container_logs
description: Retrieve recent log output lines from a specific container running inside a Kubernetes Pod.

container.description: The name of the container within the pod.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the target pod.

pod.description: The name of the target pod.

tail_lines.description: Maximum number of recent log lines to retrieve (default: 100).
